summary: Phase 136Q independently re-derived Section 46's group assignment directly from the frozen CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 contract text (not from Phase 136P's own summary), confirming Group 5 (the contract's own group 7) is exactly {PublicationAttempt, PublicationEvidence} and that ConcurrencyConflict belongs to the contract's own group 8, atomically paired with RecoveryJournalEntry per CSCH-EXEC-REQ-062 -- confirming 136P's disclosed contract/task-prompt discrepancy as CONTRACT-CONFORMANT, not a defect. Independently diffed both new schemas' field tables against Sec.25/Sec.26, re-confirmed the three cas_expectation embedding sites (cutover_candidate, certification, publication_attempt) and all 11 unconditionally-required fields against Sec.24, rebuilt the $ref dependency graph from scratch with independently authored Python (no cycle found across all 16 Group 1-5 files), and independently verified manifest counts (16 entries: 7 shared + 9 records; exactly 2 tagged implementation_group 5). Built a fresh wheel and sdist, installed the wheel into a clean isolated virtualenv with no repository-working-tree paths, and ran 13 independently authored adversarial validation checks there (offline registry construction with socket.socket/socket.create_connection blocked) -- all 13 passed after correcting two errors in the test fixtures themselves (authority_disclosure shape, compatibility_mode enum value), not in the schemas. Authored a fresh, independently-derived test module, tests/test_cltr_cutover_136q_publication_schema_independent_verification.py (70 tests, zero fixtures imported from 136P's own suite): 70/70 passed. Combined Groups 1-5 + schema-runtime suite (incl. the new 136Q module): 1316/1316 passed. Fast Green: 4391/4391 passed, matching 136P's own count exactly. Full unmarked suite freshly run: 21303 passed, 21 failed -- independently confirmed via grep that none of the 21 failing node IDs touch cltr_cutover, schema_runtime, publication, 136p, or 136q. Built an isolated git worktree at the pre-136P commit (077e4e64, 136O's close) and found only 6 of the same 21 node IDs failing there, not 21 -- disclosing a new finding, NON-BLOCKING-136Q-1: the unmarked suite's 'inherited failures' composition is not a stable, frozen node-ID set across phases; it shifts with live governed-lifecycle state (tasks/TODO.md, phase-completion metadata) while happening to total 21 at this point in time; no Group 5 code is implicated in any of the 21. Re-confirmed two prior NON-BLOCKING findings (136P-1: temporary_pointer_reference's undisclosed Sec.16 trigger; 136P-2: PublicationEvidence's conditional-authoritative-generation typing choice) and the inherited manifest authoring-metadata finding (136M-2: manifest.json's implementation_group field uses local 5-phase numbering, not the contract's own Sec.46 11-group numbering), all unchanged. Zero Blocking findings; no repair was necessary or performed. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. No ConcurrencyConflict, RecoveryJournalEntry, ReconciliationResult, QuarantineRecord, notification/marker/receipt binding, CompatibilityState, HistoricalAuthorityReference, typed model, semantic validator, or authority resolver/state/pointer was created or changed by Phase 136Q. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR RECOVERY SCHEMA IMPLEMENTATION. Recommended next phase: 136R -- Recovery Schema Implementation (contract group 8: ConcurrencyConflict, RecoveryJournalEntry).
